name: Ono Miku
source: Miku is the cool and silent beauty who is ignored by the rest of the class. She doesn’t talk to anyone, but she does talk to Masayuki for some reason. Miku talks to him always at the corridor, just before the bell rings and she always cleans the classroom after class every day.
translation: Miku is the cool and silent beauty who is ignored by the rest of the class. She doesn’t talk to anyone, but she does talk to Masayuki for some reason. Miku talks to him always at the corridor, just before the bell rings and she always cleans the classroom after class every day.
